newsitem.title: UK: IOC takes at least five September Dubai - trade.
newsitem.headline: IOC takes at least five September Dubai - trade.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corporation purchased at least five cargoes of Dubai crude in its September tender, traders said on Friday.
They said that IOC had possibly taken all seven Dubai cargoes offered into the tender but there was no immediate confirmation of that number of purchases.
Intermonth Dubai spreads firmed on speculation surrounding the result of the tender with bids for September versus October Dubai moving to parity from -10 cents a barrel.
There was no immediate information on whether the IOC had taken other crude grades in addition to Dubai.
Two cargoes of Egyptian Gulf of Suez plus two Nigerian Qua Iboe VLCCs and a VLCC of Nigerian Bonny Light were also offered into the tender.
In its August tender, IOC bought four cargoes of Dubai, a VLCC of Escravos, a cargo of Gulf of Suez and two VLCCs of Qua Iboe.
